```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's litigation system is broken.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Junk and frivolous lawsuits are driving up the cost of doing business in America by forcing companies to pay excessive legal expenses to fight off or settle often baseless lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those costs are being paid by small business owners, manufacturers, their employees, and consumers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A typical small business with $10 million in annual revenue pays about $150,000 a year in tort liability costs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"That $150,000 could be used to invest and hire new employees.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Inefficiency and waste in the legal system is costing the average American family of four $1,800 every year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"That $1,800 is equivalent to an extra 3 percent tax on wages.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Injured persons on average collect less than 50 cents of every dollar that the legal system costs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trial lawyers get rich from the misfortune of others.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trial lawyers cost hundreds of thousands of good jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trial lawyers drive honest employers out of business.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trial lawyers deprive women of critical medical care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trial lawyers skip out with fat wallets and nary a thought for the economic havoc and human misery they leave in their wake.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
